toolchainRoot.description: Optional toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, /opt/matos-tools, then the configured host toolchain root.

probe.description: Whether to run lightweight version/import probes. Defaults to true.

smoke.description: Whether to solve tiny CLI and PySCIPOpt MILP smoke problems. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-probe timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10.
